Profile Collagenase is a proteolytic enzyme derived from the fermenta- tion of Clostridium histolyticum and has the ability to break down collagen. Preparations containing collagenase are used topically for the debridement of dermal ulcers and burns, and possibly other necrotic lesions, to facilitate granulation and epi- thelialisation.
